issue_description: Heap-use-after-free in libxml2's encoding cleanup: xmlCharEncCloseFunc (encoding.c) is invoked on an encoding handler that has already been freed during HTML output processing (htmlSaveFileFormat in HTMLtree.c / xmlOutputBufferClose in xmlIO.c). This leads to reads from freed heap memory, causing crashes or memory corruption and presenting a potential security risk when processing crafted HTML/XML input (e.g., via xmllint).
